db.clean_start: WhatsMine starts fresh in this version. Your old chats and key were removed, so add your contacts again.
db.recovered: Your message database was damaged and has been reset. The damaged copy was kept next to it.
db.volatile: Messages can't be saved on this device right now. They will be lost when you close the app.
net.offline: No connection. Messages will be sent when you're back online.
onboarding.tagline: Chat without servers, accounts or phone numbers. What's yours stays yours.
onboarding.no_servers: No servers in between: your phone talks directly to theirs.
onboarding.key: No phone number. You get a key that only you have; share it with people you trust.
onboarding.yours: Your chats live only on your device. Nobody can read, sell or delete them.
onboarding.name_hint: Only shown to people you connect with. You can change it later.
chats.title: Chats
chats.empty_subtitle: Tap the button below and share your key, or paste someone else's.
chat.pending_note: Waiting for {name} to accept your request. You can already write; your messages are delivered once they accept.
chat.empty: Say hi! Messages go straight to their device, encrypted.
add.title: Add someone
add.your_key_hint: Show this code or send your link. Whoever opens it can ask to chat; you choose whether to accept.
add.request_hint: They'll see a request and choose whether to accept.
add.err.invalid_key: That doesn't look like a WhatsMine key. Check it and try again.
requests.title: Requests
requests.empty_subtitle: When someone adds you with your key, you decide here whether to accept.
requests.outgoing_hint: They see your request the next time you're both online.
contact.title: Contact
contact.key_hint: To be sure this is really them, compare this key with the one on their phone, in person.
contact.block_message: They can't reach you anymore and won't be told. You can unblock them under Contacts.
contact.delete_message: {name} is removed from your contacts and the chat is deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.read_receipts_hint: If you turn this off, you won't see other people's read receipts either.
settings.last_seen_hint: If you turn this off, you won't see other people's last seen either.
settings.typing_hint: Let contacts see when you're typing, and see when they are.
settings.about_text: No servers, no accounts, no phone numbers. Your messages are stored only on your devices.
settings.about_limits: Messages are delivered when both of you are online at the same time.
settings.wipe: Delete my identity and all chats
settings.wipe_hint: There's no backup anywhere. Once deleted, it's gone for good.
settings.wipe_message: Your key, contacts and all messages are erased from this device. People will no longer be able to reach you on your old key. The app will close.
attach.unavailable: Can't open the file picker here.
voice.no_permission: Allow the microphone to record voice messages, then try again.
voice.failed: Couldn't start recording. Is a microphone connected?
camera.error: Can't use the camera. Check that no other app is using it and that it's allowed.
file.open_failed: No app found to open this file.
file.waiting: Waiting for them to be online…
file.declined: Not accepted: it's larger than their limit.
file.over_limit: Larger than your limit. Raise it in Settings and ask them to send it again.
settings.photo_hint: Your contacts can see this picture.
settings.max_file_hint: Bigger files are declined automatically and the sender is told.
call.unavailable: You can only call contacts who are online.
call.err.mic: Can't use the microphone. Allow it and try again.
call.err.cam: Can't use the camera. Allow it and try again.
call.err.media: Something went wrong with the call audio or video.
group.name: Group name
group.no_contacts: Add a contact first: groups are made of your contacts.
group.inactive_short: You are no longer in this group
group.inactive: You're no longer in this group. You can read the history, but not write.
group.remove_message: They will no longer get this group's messages.
group.leave_message: You will keep the history but get no new messages.
group.leave_admin_message: You made this group, so leaving ends it for everyone.
group.delete_message: This removes the group and its messages from this device.
group.err.too_many: A group can have at most 16 members.
group.err.not_a_contact: Only your contacts can be added.
group.err.already_member: They are already in the group.
group.err.not_admin: Only the admin can do this.
settings.notifications_hint: Tell me about new messages, requests and calls when the app is not in front.
settings.previews_hint: Off: notifications only say that something came in.
settings.background_hint_android: A quiet service keeps your connection open, so messages and calls arrive at once even when the app is closed. It has a small notification you can hide.
settings.background_hint_desktop: Closing the window keeps WhatsMine running in the tray, so messages and calls arrive at once.
settings.autostart_hint: Starts hidden in the tray when you sign in.
settings.battery_ok: Battery: unrestricted, so the connection stays open.
settings.battery_hint: To keep the connection open while the phone sleeps, allow unrestricted battery use.
contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.empty_subtitle: People you add show up here, even after you delete their chat.
contacts.blocked_hint: Blocked people can't reach you. Unblock them to chat again.
chats.delete_message: The messages are deleted from this device. {name} stays in your contacts, and a new message from them opens the chat again.
forward.title: Forward to…
invite.blocked: You blocked {name}. Unblock them first to add them again.
invite.title: Add {name}?
invite.body: They get a request and choose whether to accept. Check that this is the right person.
contact.mute_hint: Messages still arrive, you just aren't notified.
contact.delete_chat_message: The messages are deleted from this device. {name} stays in your contacts, and a new message from them opens the chat again.
add.scan_hint: Hold the code inside the frame
add.link_copied: Link copied. Send it to someone; opening it adds you.
add.clipboard: There's an invitation on your clipboard.
